$comment: Every source in this package is now TypeScript, so `tsc` covers all of it. Until Phase 6 layer 5 there was a second half — `src/svelte`, excluded here and checked by `svelte-check`, because tsc cannot resolve a `.svelte` import at all and the usual `declare module '*.svelte'` workaround types every component as `any`, which is worse than not checking them. That split was by capability rather than preference, and deleting the Svelte sources is what removed the need for it.
$comment_jsx: `jsx` and the DOM lib are set here rather than in the base config because most of the repository is plain TypeScript that renders nothing. `react-jsx` rather than `react`, so components do not have to import React to use JSX.
